name: Palworld
description: Open-world creature-collecting survival for up to 32 players. Dedicated server installed via SteamCMD (anonymous).

variables.label: RCON port
variables.description: Only used if RCONEnabled=True is set in PalWorldSettings.ini.

variables.label: RCON password
variables.description: Must match AdminPassword in PalWorldSettings.ini (RCON also requires RCONEnabled=True there). Leave empty if RCON is disabled.

notes: Server settings (name, password, RCON, rates) live in Pal/Saved/Config/LinuxServer/PalWorldSettings.ini (WindowsServer on Windows); copy DefaultPalWorldSettings.ini there if it is missing. Saves live under Pal/Saved/SaveGames/. Remove -publiclobby from the start command for an invite-only server. Windows hosts: set the start command override to PalServer.exe with the same arguments.
